tools.name: check_modelo_210
tools.description: Says whether the owner of a Spanish home likely owes a Modelo 210 for 2025, the deadline, and, with a catastral value, a rough tax range. The same answer as the free check on calmatax.com. Asks for no personal details.

tools.description: Works out the 2025 Modelo 210 imputed-income tax, in euros, for one or more Spanish homes that are not let all year, with the formula shown, the deadline, the Calma Tax price and a link to the order form already filled in with these figures. tools.name: get_calma_tax_service
